intro: Sri Lanka has about 22 million people, mostly Sinhalese, with large Tamil and Muslim communities.

chapters.title: Peoples and faiths
text: About three-quarters are Sinhalese, mostly Buddhist. Tamils, mostly Hindu, live mainly in the north, east and hill country. Muslims make up about a tenth, and there are Christians in every group.
Sinhala and Tamil are official languages.

chapters.title: Life
text: Sri Lanka has high literacy and free education and health care. Colombo is the biggest city.
